abstract: We here propose a mitochondria-centered reinterpretation of the ACSF3 regulatory variant reported by Zhang et al., integrating advances in mitochondrial fatty acid synthesis and ACSF3-deficient models to link subcellular control of oxidative efficiency with organismal traits such as basal metabolic rate, height, and systemic growth regulation in humans.
